content.title: Chapter 30 - ELECTIONS — Sec. 30-71. - Removal of name from petition.
content.summary:
Any person who seeks to remove their name from a recall petition shall follow the
               procedure set forth in
section 30-40
.
(Code 1981, § 11-42; Ord. No. 3511, § 2, 2-1-1999)
